as_told.title: Lacatski confirms the US has a craft and that he accessed the inside

plain: This story is about a government scientist named James Lacatski, who is said to have walked inside a craft of unknown origin held by the United States. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Lacatski told a filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, on Corbell's podcast Weaponized that he stepped inside the hull of a craft. If true, it would mean the government holds a real non-human craft and has been able to get inside it. A Pentagon scientist, Eric Davis, says he heard it from Lacatski himself, who described breaching the hull and walking inside, and points to Lacatski's book. Corbell tells it firsthand too, saying Lacatski was allowed to say that the government has a UFO and has accessed its inside, and that it sat in an aerospace hangar. A Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, says he fully believes Lacatski, and both he and Corbell also credit a journalist, George Knapp.
